page.overview:
Who is Dakron?

Dakron was a Human male Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was responsible for the Krikthasi Massacre. Dakron was killed during the Battle of Balmorra by a Republic spacer who was sent by SIS Agent Protarius to eliminate him.
